summary.text: Scott Timko is the Republican candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 12, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Brandon Dukes (D).
He defeated Ethan Nicholas in the May 19, 2026 Republican primary, and he also ran in the August 18, 2026 special election for the same seat, which Dukes won.

paragraphs.text: Timko ran for the District 12 Republican nomination in 2020, when incumbent Daryl Metcalfe defeated him in the June 2 primary, and again in 2022, when he finished third in the Republican primary won by Stephenie Scialabba.
Ballotpedia also lists him among withdrawn or disqualified candidates in the 2020 Republican primary for U.S. House Pennsylvania District 17.
